newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX index reaches new highs at 3,700 pts.
newsitem.headline: German DAX index reaches new highs at 3,700 pts.

text.p: Germany's blue-chip DAX index climbed over three quarters of a percent in early bourse trade on Friday to break the key 3,700 level as Wall Street's strong overnight performance and a firm dollar lent support.
The DAX index traded up 27.67 points at 3,700.74 points, up slightly from pre-bourse electronic trading levels, breaking the psychologically key 3,700 point level for the first time ever.
But dealers were concerned whether the market would be able to muster sufficient momentum to break through that level.

Among the day's most notable movers is carbon and graphite group SGL Carbon which slumped 8.65 percent to 237.70 marks in early bourse trade on news that competition authorities in Europe and the United States were investigating the group.
SGL Carbon, which had become a clear market favourite since its bourse listing two years ago, said it would participate in the investigation.
Chemical industry stocks including Hoechst AG, Bayer AG and BASF AG all traded higher, enjoying the prospect of a firmer dollar which makes their exports cheaper abroad.
Deutsche Telekom shares climbed by 75 pfennigs to 39.90 marks, gaining support from a recommendation from a U.S. securities house.
